fields.to: Board of Directors; Audit Committee Chair
fields.subject: Cybersecurity incident: status and decisions requested
fields.handling: Confidential. Prepared with the advice of counsel.
fields.situation: At 11:15 a.m. management found ransomware on systems at two plants. Outside counsel has engaged a forensic firm. The disclosure committee meets at 8:00 a.m. tomorrow to consider materiality.
known: Production scheduling is down at the Dayton and Reno plants.
The attacker left a note demanding payment within seven days.
Backups for the finance systems are intact; plant backups are being tested.
unknown: Whether any personal or customer data left the network.
How long full recovery of the plants will take.
The size of the financial impact; the CFO's first range is $4 to $18 million.
actionsTaken: Outside counsel engaged to direct the forensic firm so the work is privileged.
Insurer notified; the policy requires its approval before any contact with the attacker.
Law enforcement contact opened through the CISO.
decisionsNeeded: Convene the full board by video at 8:30 a.m. tomorrow.
Authorize management to engage a negotiator for information only; no payment is requested tonight.
fields.nextUpdate: Friday, October 23, 2026, 8:00 a.m., before the disclosure committee meets.
